title: LemonMatrix Benchmark Result
description: A single benchmark run for one model on one configuration. Prefill and decode are always reported separately.

run_type.description: Whether this run benchmarks a direct model or a Lemonade collection.router. Defaults to 'model' when absent.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run (UUID recommended).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the run started.

name.description: Model or router name as registered in Lemonade (e.g. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, my-router).

active_parameters_b.description: Active parameters per token for MoE models, in billions.

quantization.description: Exact quant string, e.g. Q4_K_M, INT4, AWQ. Never normalize or approximate.

context_length.description: Context window used for the run.

config.description: The matrix axes for this run. Filled by the sweep.

compute_engine.description: Use 'router' when run_type is 'router'; the downstream model's engine is captured in the trial sidecar.

backend.description: e.g. llama.cpp-vulkan, llama.cpp-rocm, fastflowlm-npu. Use 'collection.router' when run_type is 'router'.

power_cap_w.description: Applied power cap in watts, if power_state is power_capped.

router_default_model.description: Router runs only. The policy's default_model — the fallback when no rule matches. Comes from route_trace.

environment.description: Fingerprint of the machine and software stack. Auto-discovered from the profile. Required for any run to be comparable.

device_model.description: e.g. HP Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo)

igpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx1151.

dgpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx950 -- confirmed more reliable than name for at least one real datacenter card whose name field was a bare numeric string.

backend_version.description: Version of the underlying engine, e.g. llama.cpp build hash.

metrics.description: Prefill and decode are reported separately because their hardware profiles differ.

stddev.description: Standard deviation of prefill tok/s across measured trials.

ci95_half_width.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval on mean prefill tok/s (Student's t, actual trial count).

stddev.description: Standard deviation of decode tok/s across measured trials.

ci95_half_width.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval on mean decode tok/s (Student's t, actual trial count).

ttft_ms_stddev.description: Standard deviation of TTFT across measured trials, milliseconds.

ttft_ms_ci95_half_width.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval on mean TTFT (Student's t, actual trial count).

trial_count.description: Number of measured (non-warmup) trials included in aggregated metrics.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact prompt text used, so two results can be confirmed to have run the identical prompt without embedding the (potentially long) prompt itself.

cost_per_1k_tokens_usd.description: Derived from the cost model: amortized hardware plus energy at local price -- the sum of energy_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd and hardware_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, whichever of the two were computable.

energy_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd.description: The energy-only component of cost_per_1k_tokens_usd. Requires Lemonade to report power draw, which no real instance checked so far does.

energy_price_usd_per_kwh.description: Local electricity price used for the cost figure, if reported.

hardware_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd.description: The hardware-amortization component of cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: (hardware_cost_usd / hardware_lifetime_hours) spread over decode tokens/sec.

hardware_cost_usd.description: Purchase price of the hardware used for the cost figure, if reported.

hardware_lifetime_hours.description: Expected service life in hours used to amortize hardware_cost_usd, if reported.

routing.description: Router runs only: where the router sent each measured request and what that cost, against sending every request to baseline_model. Prices are USD per million tokens, from a caller override, Lemonade's estimated_cost, or free for non-cloud candidates.

local_share.description: Share of requests routed to a non-cloud candidate.

free_share.description: Share of requests routed to a candidate priced at zero.

baseline_cost_usd.description: Cost of sending every request to baseline_model. Requests it did not serve are priced at the tokens it produced for the same prompt when measured, else at the routed model's tokens (see baseline_method).

baseline_method.description: measured: every request the baseline did not serve was priced on the baseline's own measured tokens. estimated: none were (older results have no field and are estimated). partial: some measurements failed.

baseline_estimated_requests.description: Requests priced at the routed model's tokens because no baseline measurement exists for their prompt.

validity.description: Confounder controls. A run that fails a gate must set valid=false and record why.

valid.description: False if any hard gate failed. Invalid runs are shown but never ranked.

warmup_discarded.description: True if warmup iterations were excluded from timing.

thermal_ok.description: False if temperature crossed the throttle threshold during measurement.

exclusive_run.description: True if no competing GPU/NPU workload ran during measurement.

model_reload_free.description: True if the model stayed resident for the whole run (no unload tax).

prompt_cache_free.description: True if no measured trial reused prompt tokens from the server's prompt cache, so TTFT and prefill time the whole prompt. Absent when the backend does not report it, and in results from LemonMatrix 0.1.0 and earlier, whose TTFT and prefill are cache-assisted.

notes.description: Any flags, caveats, or reasons a gate failed.
